items.title: Benny Golson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Dennis Hasbrook. [INTERVIEWEE] Is that his name? He was playing the President.

ctx.x: No, I never thought it, even though, at the end of the 18th century, there were some blacks in Congress and whatnot, but that was short-lived. That died out. No, I never thought I’d see, in my time, a black President. Although there was a film that came out with that in mind. James Earl Jones played the President. It was supposed to be a t.v. thing, and they decided to make it a theater feature. It was called The Man. I don’t know if you remember that. He was the first black American President. More recently,…
Is that his name? He was playing the President.
